target_customer: Students, researchers, knowledge workers and creators who learn from many sources
problem: Linear note apps make it hard to understand and connect complex material; Heptabase offers whiteboards of cards to build understanding visually.
business_model: Consumer and prosumer SaaS subscription with a 7 day trial
product_category: Visual note-taking and knowledge base software

founders.name: Alan Chan
education: National Taiwan University, Physics and Math (2016), left
founders.background_notes: Dropped out of both to pursue better ways of learning, per YC page.

founders.name: Yeefun Lin
founders.background_notes: Self-taught software engineer per YC page.

founders.name: Ethan Wu
education: Electronics engineering background, university not named

competitors.name: Roam Research
competitors.what: Networked note-taking tool for connected thought
competitors.traction_then: launched in 2019 and popular among note-taking enthusiasts per The Hustle

technical_complexity.rationale: A whiteboard and card editor with local first sync across desktop and mobile is standard but nontrivial for a team of three.

defensibility.rationale: User knowledge accumulates inside the product and a loyal community forms around it, but note apps are numerous and features are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows incumbents copying the whiteboard-card model in a way that stopped Heptabase; it is still active in 2026.

market_need_then: Note-taking and tools for thought drew heavy investor interest by 2020, shown by the 9M seed for Roam Research, and Heptabase's early community grew to about 6000 members in 82 countries by March 2023.

branding.name_origin: Founder Alan Chan says the project was first called project-meta in 2021, then renamed Heptabase after the science fiction story Story of Your Life, where Heptapod aliens use a visual language (founder quote seen in a search snippet, source page not opened).

identity.voice_and_tone: Thoughtful, learning focused: AI gives you answers. Heptabase builds your worldview.

branding.brand_signature: The Heptapod inspired name and the Product Hunt Golden Kitty and Top Post badges

rebrands.why: Founder says Facebook became Meta, so they changed the name and took one from a sci-fi story.

branding.community_and_virality: Discord server, r/heptabase subreddit, Medium blog, public roadmap and a user whiteboard gallery per the company site; community of about 6000 members in 82 countries in March 2023.

brand_strength.rationale: An active community and Product Hunt recognition exist, but brand awareness is niche among note-taking users.

outcome_analysis: Heptabase grew a loyal visual note-taking user base, joined YC W22 and raised a 1.7M seed from YC, Kleiner Perkins and others, then kept a small team while adding AI and mobile apps. It is active in 2026. Revenue and user numbers in third party profiles conflict, so scale is uncertain, but there is no sign of distress.
notes: Seed date conflict: Taiwan News says March 27, 2023 and CB Insights lists March 2023 plus a January 2022 convertible note; Seedtable and a June 2022 The Bridge headline point to 2022. Taiwan News does not name investors; investors are taken from the YC page and one aggregator-linked report (1.68M). Totals of 2.2M are from CB Insights. A claim of bootstrapping and 200K MRR (doolpa) and 7M ARR (fueler) are unverified. YC lists location Manchester, other sources say Taipei. Competition was searched with date terms; only Roam Research had a dated source.
